description: This Java class 'IntegrationConfiguration' models configuration settings for external system integrations, including environment identifiers, module codes, active status, and key/value options, with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the configuration data for integrating with external gateways, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code identifying the integration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code used to identify the integration.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the integration is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the integration.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: setIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Sets the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with primary configuration info.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire configuration object into a JSON string.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the environment for the integration (e.g., TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration options.

methods.name: setIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Sets the map of integration options.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if this configuration is the default selection.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Specifies whether this configuration is the default.
